title: Past pass visits change company or disappear when a member's pass box is changed
what: A check-in by the gym's QR in the member app is saved without a pass company. The monthly pass count gives it to whatever company the member has today. If the desk unticks the pass box, every past QR visit of that member drops out of the old months. If the desk changes FITPASS to cultpass, all the old QR visits move to cultpass. If the box is ticked again later, the start day resets to today and the earlier QR visits stay uncounted. Desk check-ins keep their company, so the two kinds of visit drift apart. The owner matches the pass company's payment against a count that can change after the month is closed.
expected: Every pass visit keeps the company it was made under, so a past month's count never changes when the member's details change.
how_often: each time a pass member's pass box is changed
fix_line: Save the pass company on each visit when it is made, the QR check-in included

title: Every receipt for a plan says it includes the joining fee, even a small later part payment
what: When a plan has a joining fee, each receipt against that plan prints the line that it includes a one-time joining fee of that amount. A member paying in parts gets the same line on the second and third receipt too, and on a receipt smaller than the fee itself. An accountant reading the receipts would count the joining fee more than once.
expected: The joining fee line shows only on the receipt that took it, or reads as the plan's fee, not as part of this payment.
how_often: every part payment on a plan with a joining fee
fix_line: Word the line as the plan's joining fee, or print it on the first receipt only

items.reason: Read the money logic of all 9 features. Pay MettleUp prices come from the one price list and match the server's price list (999/9,990/1,499/14,990). Join-online Approve, receipts (numbering, GST split, tax invoice), WhatsApp fee/renewal/receipt messages and imports were read; imports never invent money and cap receipt dates at today with no GST stamp. Two new faults: pass visit count (FN-L5-panel-logic-2-01) and the joining fee line on every receipt (FN-L5-panel-logic-2-02). Already known and reused: extra branch charged full price on Pay MettleUp (FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-02), owner-typed amount not compared to price (FN-L5-panel-screens-2-02), GST number turns prices GST-inclusive (FN-L5-panel-screens-2-04). Workout plans (F-panel-737) hold no money.

A test-mode join payment never becomes money: Approve makes the member with nothing collected, the card says no real money came in, and the receipts sweep marks it test mode. Pay MettleUp has no test mode (manual UPI or bank). The member-app side of test mode is already FN-L5-server-panel-worker-01; no new fault in this area.

Pay MettleUp: pending, confirmed and rejected each have words; a rejected reference can be sent again (the duplicate check skips rejected). Join payments: paid, said, failed, started, expired (read as not paid) and cancelled (desk) are handled, and a payment refunded before Approve is checked with the company first. Free trial (selfJoin) soon/on/ended handled; trial fee is always 0 on the server, so no paid trial path exists. Owner trial and paid plan ending/ended banners checked. MettleUp Plus lock after a member's plan ends is a shared switch. Refund after a receipt is saved is already FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-06.

The paid-until date the owner reads before paying (trial kept) uses the same rule as the server and the HQ list (0063 _paid_from, 0064 extendsTo). Trial length on the sign-up line matches the refund page (3 months). The WhatsApp receipt says a still-due amount only when the gym has a UPI ID and then uses the member's whole due, while the printed receipt shows the one plan's balance: same root as FN-L5-panel-screens-2-03, reused. Renewal messages use the plan's current price, the same price the sell sheet starts with.
